name: Pen to Paper
source:
An experimental hybrid of a visual novel with a journaling game. You and the narrator tell the story of a traveller leaving home to seek something special, you decide the details as the journey is carried out.

[From [url=https://superbiasedgary.itch.io/pen-to-paper]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
视觉小说与日记游戏的实验性混合体。你和叙述者讲述了一个旅行者离家去寻找特别的东西的故事，你在旅程的进行中决定细节。

[来自[url=https://superbiasedgary.itch.io/pen-to-paper]Itch.io[/url]]
